decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed advertisements, due to the compatible scale, appearance and position of the proposed banner and illuminated sails structures, would be compatible with the commercial appearance of the area, would not harm the adjoining businesses or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with policies IMP.2.2 (Regeneration of Hounslow Town Centre), ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of illuminated sails structure within canopy and non-illuminated flag/banner in front of canopy
